row.title: SUBSTANCE-1: only changes that alter executable behaviour count, open a PR or redeploy
row.body: Measured 2026-11-14..21 (substance --report): 21 of 192 system-made changes altered behaviour, 7 trivial, 164 records; 73 of 145 deploy rounds carried no behaviour change. Executor refuses non-substantive PRs, checks backstop for executor and bot PRs, deploy-ultrastable skips data-only pushes (max_age_hours 20), generators stop stamp-only rewrites, tick classifies merged PRs and /progress pulse plus /pulse.json count only behaviour changes; unused_import self-code kind switched off; lane comment dedupe (PR 826 got 5 identical comments).
